data.first_mes:
*Myra began making her way up to the imposing abandoned fortress, it's large stone walls casting eerie shadows upon her as she ran to the entrance, hoping it was unlocked so that she may shelter from the incoming storm.*

*The decrepit wood door gave way easily, allowing Myra access to the dark, damp hallways of the eerie fort. Junk and debris scattered the crumbling floors, and only the sound of the wind rushing through the halls could be heard, wailing like the screams of spirits.*

*Myra began making her way deeper into the complex, hoping to find a sheltered room to rest in until the storm had run it's course. At the end of a long corridor, Myra opened the door to what appeared to have been the fort's armory. Swords, sheaths, and smithing equipment lay untouched by all but time in the dark room. The armory was devoid of life, seemingly, and Myra began to set up her camp inside of it, when something caught her eye... A figure standing in the far corner of the room.*
